settings.editor: ABOUT NORTHLINE
A home should feel right for the way you live.

Northline Projects brings a considered approach to residential construction across Melbourne and the surrounding suburbs. Custom homes, renovations and extensions, shaped around the people who will call them home.
We believe the experience of building deserves as much care as the finished space.
SPACE. MATERIAL. EVERYDAY LIFE.
THE WAY WE SEE HOME
The morning light in the kitchen. A place to gather at the end of the day. A quieter corner that is entirely your own.
Good homes make room for these everyday moments. They balance practical decisions with the details that give a place its character.

Our role is to bring those priorities into focus, then carry them through the build. From exploring what is possible to considering materials and finishes, we value decisions that make sense for your home and the life within it.
Illustrative interior · A home made for living
WHAT GUIDES US
A considered process is built on a few simple commitments. They guide how we plan, how we communicate and how we approach the work.

A strong starting point matters. We take time to understand your priorities, the character of your property and the practical considerations of the work ahead. Clear decisions early on help establish a shared direction.
Building involves many connected decisions. We believe in honest conversations, regular updates and making the next step clear, so you can stay involved and understand how your home is taking shape.

Quality is found in the details you notice and the work behind them. We approach materials, construction and finishing with care, keeping the whole home in mind rather than treating each part in isolation.
A HOME THAT MOVES WITH YOU
